Is it ok for me to genuinely enjoy Tamers12345's content despite the overly offensive jokes featured in his vids? Don't get me wrong 🍇 jokes make me uncomfortable, even in the context of his vids and I've seen a lot of people slandering him for being "controversial". BUT AT THE SAME TIME, shows like South Park exist which ALSO have 🍇 jokes and use offensive humour strikingly similar to Tamers12345. 

(I'm also not completely sure about this) but I'm pretty sure they've stated at least ONCE that despite the fact that their videos are made from content of video games or franchises made up of minors such as Dandy's World, MLP and Sonic the hedgehog. They've stated that their videos are NOT meant for children and are only targetted towards 18+ or mature audiences. Although I'm still a bit weirded out that despite their content not being made for kids they still choose to not age restrict some of their videos/make content about franchises that have young audiences I genuinely like their videos and (not to say that their actions are justified) but there are tones of content out there, in and outside of YouTube. That have controversial humour and aren't made for kids, like the Cupcakes MLP video or the "Stay outa my shed" MLP video. 

I hate being the type of person that tries to say "Well! What they're doing is ok because I've seen worse!!!!" or "What they're doing is ok because other people do it to!!!". So I'm trying desperately not to say that but, stuff like this has been happening for YEARS now.. And I feel like Tamers12345's content is no different from what haters may enjoy such as South Park or MLP infection au's.

I like Tamers12345's videos but I don't want people to compare me liking his vids to people who like The Coffin of Andy and LeyLey or Hazbin Hotel. Pieces of media that are genuinely controversial.
